not_claimed: This ledger does not count outreach attempts as users, feedback, business impact, or GitHub stars.
A resume outcome row becomes claimable only after accepted public, non-owner evidence reaches its threshold.
Private replies and self-authored planning issues are excluded from resume outcome counts.

outcome_rows.allowed_resume_wording_after_threshold: Received external AI Engineer review of the tool-calling loop, guardrails, structured output, and evidence trail.
outcome_rows.evidence_gate: A non-owner public review issue lists inspected paths and grants permission to count.
outcome_rows.label: AI Engineer review
outcome_rows.next_action: Ask one AI/ML systems reviewer to inspect the agent loop, guardrails, traces, and AI Engineer readiness evidence.
outcome_rows.reviewer_profile: AI engineer, mentor, or ML systems reviewer

outcome_rows.allowed_resume_wording_after_threshold: Validated the data-quality LLM agent with 1 external reviewer who ran the public demo or local repo.
outcome_rows.evidence_gate: A non-owner public GitHub issue confirms the path tried and includes permission to count.
outcome_rows.label: Confirmed external user
outcome_rows.next_action: Ask one peer to open the public demo or local quickstart and submit observed-result evidence.
outcome_rows.recommended_channel: class Discord, friend DM, or club Slack
outcome_rows.reviewer_profile: reviewer who opened the demo or ran the repo

outcome_rows.allowed_resume_wording_after_threshold: Converted 1 reproducible external run report into an evidence-backed fix backlog.
outcome_rows.evidence_gate: A public issue includes command or URL evidence, expected result, actual result, and environment.
outcome_rows.label: Reproducible external run or bug
outcome_rows.next_action: Ask one developer to run the Docker/local replay path and report whether the result is reproducible.
outcome_rows.recommended_channel: GitHub issue comment, Discord, or DM to a developer comfortable with Docker
outcome_rows.reviewer_profile: engineer comfortable with Docker or local setup

outcome_rows.allowed_resume_wording_after_threshold: Reviewed the agent against 1 anonymized real-world data-quality workflow and mapped the resulting risks.
outcome_rows.evidence_gate: A public business-case issue includes anonymized schema, quality failure, impact, and reviewer role.
outcome_rows.label: Business-case feedback
outcome_rows.next_action: Ask one data/ops reviewer for an anonymized real data-quality scenario and business impact mapping.
outcome_rows.recommended_channel: email or in-person ask to someone who has handled messy operational data

outcome_rows.allowed_resume_wording_after_threshold: Collected 3 public reviewer feedback items and converted them into prioritized product fixes.
outcome_rows.evidence_gate: Public feedback issues include role, path tried, outcome, improvement request, and permission.
outcome_rows.label: External feedback
outcome_rows.next_action: Ask one peer to leave product or README feedback after trying the demo.
outcome_rows.recommended_channel: LinkedIn DM, class Discord, or project channel

purpose: Join reviewer outreach, public issue submission, evidence-gate acceptance, and exact resume wording into one ledger so real outcomes can be counted only after public evidence exists.
